description: Search EPA-regulated facilities by name, state, ZIP code, city, or industry code. facility_name uses a case-insensitive starts-with match; prepend % for a contains search (e.g., "%Exxon%" finds any facility with "Exxon" in its name). Combine at least two filters, a bare state is rejected upstream for large states ({state: "TX"} alone matches ~344,000 facilities and errors). Good queries: {facility_name: "%Exxon%", state: "TX"}, {city: "Baytown", state: "TX"}, {zip: "94025"}, {naics: "3251", state: "TX"}. Returns facility IDs, addresses, lat/long, compliance status, inspection/enforcement counts, and total penalties. For questions about recent enforcement actions, penalties or fines ("recent EPA enforcement in Houston", "which Baytown plants were penalized"), pass enforcement_only: true with city/state: it keeps only facilities with a penalty from a formal action in the last 5 years and ranks them by total penalties, largest first, instead of listing facilities alphabetically.

enforcement_only.description: true = only facilities with a penalty from a formal enforcement action in the last 5 years, ranked by total_penalties descending (the "recent enforcement actions" view). Default false: facilities in ECHO order, no enforcement filter.

facility_name.description: Facility name, starts-with match by default; use % wildcard for contains search, e.g., "%Exxon%" or "%Baytown%".

naics.description: NAICS industry code, 2-6 digits, prefix match (e.g., "3251" = basic chemical manufacturing). Pair with state; alone it matches too many facilities.

name: echo_facility_search

naics_codes.description: North American Industry Classification System codes

quarters_in_noncompliance.description: Number of quarters facility was in non-compliance

rcra_status.description: Resource Conservation and Recovery Act compliance status

registry_id.description: EPA Registry ID for the facility

sdwis_status.description: Safe Drinking Water Information System status

returned.description: Number of facilities returned in this response

total_count.description: Total number of facilities matching search criteria
